audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Shane’s recovery conversation, Alex’s saloon sports room, and Gus’s giant-omelet gathering. Every spoken line, addiction-recovery statement, sports call, funding message, character joke, cooking description, farm-name placeholder, and group reaction was reviewed in full event context against the canonical Ukrainian glossary. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, mail and order conditions, placeholders, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and all non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. This completes the Saloon event asset; full-locale final audits remain pending.
